notes.title: UPDATE 0.98 - New Graphical Enhancment for Eva When In Bounce 'Kill' Mode + More
notes.content:
With Update 0.98 here, I've made Eva all sparkly and 'cooler' looking when you bounce off of a wall and go into block destruction mode.  Eva used to just be a solid very light grey color when in this mode and now looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119922/f2fd07d0183dd4e760514d0cbca96f680a580fc2.jpg[/img]

-------------------

And when you bounce off a wall and have also have drank a puddle of water so you can distinguish fires, you'll be a shiny sparkly blue color instead as seen here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119922/6e4f1fc8101a282c61b479aeaa52a380fd92cedb.jpg[/img]

When Eva is on fire, which means you are scoring no points and you bounce off of a wall to go into destruction mode, Eva will look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119922/dfb8e9d2e26a741f73f7a86e9e168f78d8c46786.jpg[/img]

-------------------

Other changes made in this update are:

- You can now immediately move to a new game much quicker when you crash or die by pressing your space bar or the A button on your controller.  You'll also now hear two quick dings when you restart the game before you see the "Game Over" on your screen and press the "Play Again" button.

- You will no longer hear an unnecessary gulping water sound if you move over a water puddle if you are already blue and have water ready to extinguish a fire or block on fire.


Not a massive update here, but just a few small details have been added to hopefully make the game a little more enjoyable to play!

Game on Gamers!


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.97 - Easier To Collect Apples, Power-Ups, and Anger Decreased!
notes.content:
A pretty small update here, but more changes that I firmly believe make playing this game a more enjoyable experience..

* Apples and power-ups have a bigger hit box that means they are MUCH easier to collect than before.

* Added Pause Game functionality.  Hit the ESCAPE key, the SPACE BAR or the START button on a controller while playing the game to PAUSE the game.  From there, hitting the space bar or the START button on the controller will resume the game, while pressing the ESCAPE key while paused will exit the current game and move back to the game welcome screen.

* The "Anger Increased" words have been decreased in size and move right under the Block Anger meter at the top right of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119922/2246357872227bb2091ee2e33350af0799f4a19f.png[/img]

..Fixed an issue from version 0.96 where the yellow explanation point to warn of a shooter block would not disappear if you killed the shooter block.

..Stopped the music from playing on the main welcome screen and on the high score screen if you went to either after playing a game.

6 New Steam Achievements have been added to the game in this update, bringing the total now to 27.

* 1 Million Total Points:  Score more than 1,000,000 total points in your stats (all your games)
* 5 Million Total Points:  Score more than 5,000,000 total points in your stats (all your games)
* 10 Million Total Points:  Score more than 10,000,000 total points in your stats (all your games)
* 25 Million Total Points:  Score more than 25,000,000 total points in your stats (all your games)
* 100 Bounces (Game):  Bounce off the walls 100 or more times in a single game.
* 25 Bounce Kills (Game):  Kill 25 or more blocks with reflections off of the walls in a single game.

If you pass 25 million total points and get this achievement, you will earn yourself ANY of my Steam games that I have developed and the choice is yours.  To get your reward, email me at ZaxtorGameS@yahoo.com with your Steam user name, a screenshot of your STATS screen in the game that shows your 25 million or more total points, and also a screen shot showing your Steam profile and your total hours recorded in B..:EvaSive!   Also be sure you let me know what Steam game I've made that you would like a Steam key for as your reward.

* Earning a free Steam game requires that you actually earn the 25,000,000 points total without using cheats, hacks or any bots.  Validation of this will be confirmed by myself and my decision will be final on whether you earn the free Steam key or not.  Please provide the mentioned and required screenshots as proof of your earning the reward.


Thanks for reading and I hope that you are enjoying my game!

- ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.96 - IMPORTANT CHANGES!!
notes.content:
Hello all, just a few important little changes to this game the day after launch..

* A seizure and epilepsy warning was added that you'll see and cannot skip every time you launch the game.  You'll only see this once every time you launch the game, and not before every replay however.

* With this update, you'll now get warnings ahead of time that a block is set to move onto the screen before you see the block!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119922/27d801516685c2221a117b8c82f4a5443edab7cc.png[/img]

* I changed the game so that you should now never see more than one block hurling itself at you (spinning end over end and moving at high speeds) at any given time, no matter how high the "block anger" might be.

* The blocks will now no longer hurl themselves across the screen if the block anger seen in the top-right UI is less than around 12-15.  This will hopefully prevent  brand new players from getting smacked by a spinning block flying across the screen when they've barely started. 

* You'll now see yellow explanation points appear just a split second before and during the gunfire from any angry block that decides to try and shoot you down.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119922/53f49f6c48f4654ebdbdcdf7c329987ac1f43ecd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119922/a8298090dd6b686ed1f04cea7a5359e33ee628a6.jpg[/img]

* If you hit a burning block at a diagonal angle while you have water, you'll extinguish the fire on the burning block and you will be able to destroy the block on the next hit an an angle while you are white (from bouncing off of a wall or eating a 'Surge' power-up)

* If you hit a burning block wile you do not have water, you'll now catch on fire and score no points for any block kills you make until you extinguish yourself by drinking a puddle of water.

* If you move over the flames that remain from a burned block, you'll now have a very high chance of catching on fire if you don't have water, but if you do have water, you'll use the water to extinguish the remaining flames.

* Killing blocks will now only trigger the "Anger Increased" words in the middle of the screen if your kill increases the block anger by 5 or more points.  If you eat an apple or kill a block that increases the block anger by less than 5 points, you won't see these words or hear the increased anger sound.  Beware though that the anger will still increase, even though it's not stated on the screen.

* It is now much easier and faster to lower the overall block anger by simply 'not killing blocks' for around 7 to 10 seconds.  While the decrease in block anger will be small every few seconds, if you play nice for a minute or so and don't bully the poor little innocent blocks, their anger should lower significantly.  =)

* The chances of seeing moving blue blocks that contain water will now be higher the more fires and burning blocks that exist on the screen.  If your snake is on fire, the chances of seeing more blue blocks will also be increased. 

* Blue blocks that have caught fire will no longer drop water when destroyed.

* Eating an apple will now slightly increase the block anger because they really enjoy squashing them!  This will mean that even players who try and avoid combat and only try and eat apples and stay safe will still eventually face the threats of angry blocks.

* I put in checks to prevent more than one of any given power-up being on the screen at a time.

* Fixed an issue that would prevent a block fire from fading out if the block had completely burned away. 



I hope you are enjoying this game!  ..Have a great day!

- ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)
